passages.text: Leucadendron uliginosum, commonly known as the Outeniqua conebush or Tsitsikamma conebush, is an evergreen flowering shrub endemic to the Western and Eastern Cape provinces of South Africa. It is a member of the Proteaceae family and is a characteristic component of the montane fynbos vegetation. It was described by and given the correct name by Robert Brown in 1810.
